recipients.name: Gravinity Star
recipients.printed_effect:
During the Main Phase, if this card is in your hand (Quick Effect): You can place this card face up in your Spell and Trap Zone as a Continuous Trap. During either player's turn, if this card is treated as a Continuous Trap: You can activate one of the following effects.
● Set 1 "Gravinity" Spell or Trap directly from your Deck. If it is your opponent's turn, it can be activated this turn.
● Move this card to another column.
You can only use each effect of "Gravinity Star" once per turn.

transfer_flag_consumers.text: if c:GetFlagEffect(TRANSFER_CALL)>0 then c:ResetFlagEffect(TRANSFER_CALL) s.setop(e,tp) end
